title: agentfund.yaml — project descriptor (spec_version 1)
description: Lives at the repo root. Declares the project and publishes the maintainer public key (channel one; the server UI is channel two).

description.description: One-liner shown on cards and OG images.

repo_url.description: Canonical https clone URL of the project repo, without a trailing .git.

ci_provider.description: Which CI adapter confirms delivery. `github` = GitHub Actions/checks; `generic` = HMAC-signed JSON posted to /v1/webhooks/ci.

pubkey.description: Maintainer Ed25519 public key in minisign format: base64 of 'Ed' || 8-byte key id || 32-byte key (56 base64 chars).

token_goal.description: Funding goal in tokens. Usually the sum of max_tokens across manifests.
